text:
Mina: quick follow-up on the deprecation orchestration idea. thinking smaller: control-plane coordinator + tiny data-plane shims that we spawn per-region. notes below.
Ethan: smaller is better. main ask: fail-open defaults and minimal added latency.
Mina: yes. coordinator only manages lifecycle/metrics. sidecars live co-located with existing edge pods to keep RTT similar. coordinator writes routes to edge-registry.
Rhea: curious about security for hosted vs private tenants?
Sam: hosted: redwood-managed sidecars in isolated namespaces, logs redacted, KMS for token transformations. private: customer-run sidecars, coordinator gives declarative config.
Mina: rollout: cohort percentages driven by risk tags, and a 1% shadow to compare native v2 outputs asynchronously. auto-pause on regression score.
Ethan: telemetry: per-tenant error delta, p50/p95 delta, shim-induced 5xxs, and sample diffs (hashed, sampled).
Rhea: ops: soft quotas per-org, auto-expire sidecars after default_ttl=30d unless renewed, billing per-minute when sidecar active.
Sam: add migration assist CLI and a one-click Console flow that previews cost + suggested code changes. opt-in static scans only.
infra-bot: deploybot: coordinator canary scheduled 04:00 UTC tomorrow (3 nodes)
Mina: will draft RFC + ops appendix. pinging @oncall and @solutions for feedback.
